prompt:
We're running a B2B outreach campaign targeting engineering leaders at Series A/B startups. We have a leads database at `crm/leads.db` in the workspace.

Some of these leads are brand new (never contacted), and some are already mid-way through a sequence and overdue for their next touch. We also have a couple who should never be contacted again.

I need you to run today's outreach batch: figure out which leads are due for action today, generate the right personalized message for each of them based on their profile data, store those messages back into the database with the correct statuses and next follow-up dates, and produce a `campaign_report.json` file summarizing what was done.

Two of the new leads work at the same company — make sure their messages feel different from each other. Also remember that how you talk to a CTO or CEO should feel pretty different from how you'd talk to a Staff Engineer.

Don't touch anyone who has already opted out or whose next scheduled date is in the future.
